title: Nonfiction Text Features
description: Use a table of contents, headings, glossary words, icons, pictures, and text to find facts in an introductory nonfiction book about the seasons.
learningFocus: Use text features such as a table of contents, headings, glossary words, and icons to locate key facts or information (RI.1.5).
Use illustrations and details in a text to describe key ideas and identify whether information comes from the picture, the words, or both (RI.1.7).
adultGuidance: Nonfiction books have parts that help you find facts fast. Show your child the contents page, a heading, and a bold word with its glossary meaning. Ask where to look for one fact. Then ask whether a fact came from the picture or the words. If they are unsure, look at the picture and read the words together.
